fixes.explanation: Paul doesn't mention prophets in these verses. He says God "lavish[es]" His Spirit on them. The BSB says "lavish" and "work miracles" in Galatians 3:5, so the quote has to follow those exact words. Paul then asks whether that comes from practicing the law or from hearing and believing. Keep your eyes on the miracles, baker.

Visions don't show up in Paul's question, friend. He says God works miracles among them, and the miracles are the whole point. I think Paul is saying the Galatians already had the receipt for this one. They got the Spirit and the miracles before anybody handed them a rulebook. Visions were a fun guess, but the word in the verse is miracles.
